features.name: Darkvision
features.detail: See in dim light within 60 ft as if bright, darkness as if dim

features.name: Otherworldly Patron
features.detail: Her magic comes from a pact with something ancient that speaks to her in dreams — she is still learning what it wants

known.name: Minor Illusion
known.detail: A sound or a small image for 1 minute, 30 ft

known.name: Thaumaturgy
known.detail: Minor wonder — booming voice, flickering flames, trembling ground (Tiefling)

known.name: Hex
known.detail: Bonus action curse: +1d6 necrotic on her hits, target disadvantage on one ability; concentration

known.name: Charm Person
known.detail: WIS save DC 13 or charmed as a friendly acquaintance for 1 hour

inventory.item: Arcane focus (a ring of dark glass)
A journal of dreams she doesn't remember having

traits: Quiet until she isn't; when she speaks, the room listens whether it wants to or not.
ideals: Power you're afraid of is power someone else will use on you.
bonds: The voice in her dreams saved her life once. She intends to find out why.
flaws: Keeps exactly one secret too many, always.
